title: Summer@EPFL
institution: EPFL School of Computer and Communication Sciences (IC)
field: Computer science, computer engineering, telecommunications, electrical engineering
about: Summer@EPFL: roughly three-month research internship (usually May-September) at EPFL's School of Computer and Communication Sciences for bachelor's and master's students. Applicants submit a CV, transcripts and motivation letter and select up to three scientific domains.
requirements: Bachelor or master student in computer science, computer engineering, telecommunications or electrical engineering
At least first bachelor year completed; PhD students not eligible

upskill.name: AI Foundations
why: "Bachelor or master student in computer science, computer engineering, telecommunications or electrical engineering" → AI Foundations Academy covers core computing topics (e.g. A001.01 "Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I", A001.07 "Computer Vision I"); no single course objective maps to the record's eligibility-only requirements, so the Academy page is used instead of a course anchor
